title: 半亩园 Banmu Yuan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 宣宗實錄: 半亩园, 1833
evidence.date: 道光十九年九月 (nearest heading in the corpus copy)
evidence.link: https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录道光朝实录.txt
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上奉皇太后幸山高水长。阅精捷营阵式。幸半亩园。进膳。
evidence.summary: The Emperor takes the Dowager to 山高水长 to see the 精捷营 drill, and to lunch at 半亩园. Nearby halls, so the 半亩园 of 坦坦荡荡 is meant.

evidence.title: Qing record naming 半亩园
evidence.locator: p.143 item (135), under 山高水长
evidence.excerpt_zh: 道光十九年十月丙戌，道光帝奉皇太后幸山高水长，阅精捷营阵式，幸半亩园，进膳。
evidence.summary: After a troop review at 山高水长, Daoguang took the dowager to dine at 半亩园, in use in 1839.

evidence.title: 半亩园 in 坦坦荡荡
evidence.summary: Five-bay hall with galleries front and back. Small plays were staged here on dates of 1852 and 1856, so a stage of some kind stood or was put up.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 坦坦荡荡
evidence.summary: The goldfish pool on the west shore: gate hall of five bays 素心堂 with a three-bay annex, 半亩园 east, 澹怀堂 west, 知鱼亭, 萃景斋, 双佳斋, and the five-bay 光风霁月 in mid-pool.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
